facts.fact: The Minister of Digital Transformation, with the Minister of Public Service, supervised the launch of a twelve-week cybersecurity and artificial-intelligence training programme for 300 civil servants from various government sectors, run by the Centre de Formation et d'Echange a Distance with the German cooperation office (AMI).
